intro.fr: Rhythm Tengoku se joue en multiworld Archipelago grâce à un APWorld communautaire, distribué hors de l'installation officielle.
intro.en: Rhythm Tengoku can be played in an Archipelago multiworld through a community APWorld, distributed outside the official install.

text.fr: Nintendo SPD Production Group No. 1 sort Rhythm Tengoku en 2006.
text.en: Nintendo SPD Production Group No. 1 releases Rhythm Tengoku in 2006.

text.fr: Publication de la première version, tengoku-v1.0.0.
text.en: The first version, tengoku-v1.0.0, is released.

text.fr: Publication de la version tengoku-v1.0.3, la plus récente des 4 versions au nom du jeu sur ce dépôt au 21 octobre 2026.
text.en: Version tengoku-v1.0.3 is released, the latest of the 4 versions named after the game on this repository as of October 21, 2026.

text.fr: Rhythm Tengoku figure dans le tableur communautaire des APWorlds, qui recense les mondes jouables hors de l'installation officielle d'Archipelago.
text.en: Rhythm Tengoku is listed in the community APWorlds spreadsheet, which tracks the worlds playable outside the official Archipelago install.
